meta.title: 什么是运镜？我用一颗苹果告诉你
meta.title_en: What Is Camera Movement? I'll Show You with an Apple

scenes.context: 运镜不只是耍帅，它能让画面讲出故事、表达感觉。
sentences: 其实除了耍帅，运镜还能讲故事。
Besides looking cool, camera movement can tell a story.
用不同的运镜，能拍出不同的感觉。
Different camera moves create different feelings.
paraphrase: 把「耍帅」换成更英式的说法
Beyond just looking slick, camera movement can tell a story.
「不同的感觉」换个说法
Different camera moves evoke different moods.
scenes.speak: I'm practicing camera movement. Besides looking cool, camera movement can tell a story. Different camera moves create different feelings.

scenes.context: 摇镜头可以渲染激烈的氛围，同时交代人物关系。
sentences: 摇镜头可以渲染激烈的氛围。
A pan shot can build an intense atmosphere.
It also establishes the relationship between characters.
这是一颗苹果的冒险故事。
It's the adventure story of an apple.
paraphrase: 把「渲染氛围」换种说法
A pan can create a tense, intense mood.
「交代关系」换个表达
It also shows how the characters are connected.
scenes.speak: This is an apple's fate. A pan shot can build an intense atmosphere. It also establishes the relationship between characters. It's the adventure story of an apple.

scenes.title_en: The Crane Down Opens the Story
scenes.context: 下降镜头从全局到主角，是电影常用的开场；上升镜头适合结尾。
sentences: 下降镜头，画面从全局到主角。
A crane down moves the shot from the wide scene to the main character.
是电影里常用的开场方式。
It's a classic way to open a film.
上升镜头则适合作为结尾。
A crane up, on the other hand, works well as an ending.
paraphrase: 把「从全局到主角」换种说法
The shot starts wide, then descends onto the hero.
「适合作为结尾」另一种表达
A rising shot is perfect for closing the scene.
scenes.speak: A crane down moves the shot from the wide scene to the main character. It's a classic way to open a film. A crane up, on the other hand, works well as an ending.

scenes.context: 明亮温馨的厨房是假象——环境本身就是叙事的一部分。
sentences: I have to get out of here.
paraphrase: 把「假象」换成更生动的说法
But it's all a facade. · facade（表象、假象）
「必须离开」另一种表达
I need to escape this place.
scenes.speak: It's bright and cozy. But it's all an illusion. I have to get out of here.

scenes.context: 推镜头放大情绪，拉镜头情绪淡化、环境成为重点。
sentences: 推镜头在交代环境的同时放大人物情绪。
A push-in magnifies the character's emotion while establishing the setting.
向后拉镜头，情绪会淡化。
学会运镜，你的视频也可以。
Master camera movement, and your videos can too.
paraphrase: 把「放大情绪」换个说法
A push-in intensifies how the character feels.
「情绪淡化」另一种表达
As the camera pulls back, the mood softens.
scenes.speak: A push-in magnifies the character's emotion while establishing the setting. Pulling back, the emotion fades. The setting becomes the focus. Master camera movement, and your videos can too.

practice: 用不同的运镜，能拍出不同的感觉。
Different camera moves create different feelings.
下降镜头，画面从全局到主角。
A crane down moves the shot from the wide scene to the main character.
学会运镜，你的视频也可以。
Master camera movement, and your videos can too.
pitfalls: The pan can render the intense atmosphere.
A pan shot can build an intense atmosphere.
build/atmosphere 搭配更自然，render 偏书面
The shot from global to the protagonist.
The shot moves from the wide scene to the main character.
表示「从…到…移动」要用 move from...to...
fade 常作不及物动词，情感自己是淡化的
A push-in magnifies the character's emotion.
第三人称单数动词不能丢 s
shifts: 推拉摇移各有叙事任务
下降开场、上升收尾有章法
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：视频原文「集谣镜头」识别为「摇镜头」，正文统一为标准术语。
